author: m.kalinin
content:
Interesting finding! I think at least at the spec level `on_block` should be idempotent, i.e. regardless of a number of calls with the same block the outcome should remain the same. In client this can be preserved by not calling `on_block` for an already processed block.

Another way of achieving that would be an early quite from `on_block` when the block is already in the store. I can't see any cons here

author: potuz
content: As noted already in the first message by <@1035747431461167125>. Block -> PTC Attestation -> Block != Block -> PTC Attestation.

author: potuz
content: So while idempotent, it does not commute with adding PTC attestations so the ordering will matter anyway.

author: potuz
content: also it's not strictly idempotent because of `record_block_timeliness`
